nodes.title: Start
nodes.description: Receive and frame the research query.

nodes.title: Goal
nodes.description: State the research objective and scope.

nodes.title: Done
nodes.description: Research report and notes are complete.

edges.prompt_template: For the query {query}, write a concrete research goal with scope, intended contribution, success criteria, and exclusions. Current artifacts: {artifacts}. Last failure: {last_failure}

Research prior work relevant to {query} and the goal. Use search and fetch, cite at least three distinct source URLs directly in the synthesis, and save a note when useful. Artifacts: {artifacts}. Last failure: {last_failure}
From the cited prior work for {query}, identify at least three concrete limitations as Markdown list items. Fetch sources when needed. Artifacts: {artifacts}. Last failure: {last_failure}
Turn the limitations into at least three specific research gaps for {query}. Use Markdown list items and explain why each matters. Artifacts: {artifacts}. Last failure: {last_failure}

Assess feasibility of every gap for {query}. For each gap give a data availability verdict and method availability verdict, using search where needed. Artifacts: {artifacts}. Last failure: {last_failure}

termination_metric.rubric: each gap has data/method availability verdict

edges.prompt_template: Design a quick discriminating test for the best feasible gap for {query}. Specify hypothesis, data, method, baseline, measurement, stopping rule, risks, and interpretation in at least 120 words. Artifacts: {artifacts}. Last failure: {last_failure}
Generate the final report and create an Obsidian research note for {query}. Use the report and note tools. Artifacts: {artifacts}. Last failure: {last_failure}
